verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs say its MCP server lets an agent "read and change the same dashboard data you can" (organizations, connections, users, branding) by calling the WorkOS API, which is a direct dashboard-to-API parity claim. A published OpenAPI spec backs this up, and RBAC is explicitly configurable "in the WorkOS Dashboard or using the API." Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that parity is complete, and explicit API equivalents for dashboard-documented settings such as enabling MFA on the Authentication page.
